primer: Coforge Limited (NSE: COFORGE) is a domain-led Indian IT and digital engineering compounder with a $2.38 billion order book and 16.0% FY27 EBIT margin guidance. Our November 2026 refresh keeps COMPOUNDER_PASS (PASS_WITH_WATCH) while flagging 110-day Q2 Total DSO and the September 2026 exits of Chairman Bhatt and NRC Chair Singh. On the verified November 23 close of ₹2,142.30 (Nov 25 TV pullback ₹2,060.00), we HOLD our 41 Zerodha shares and raise the hard stop from ₹1,659.40 to ₹1,685.64. New capital stays Tier-2 ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP strictly inside ₹1,951.99–₹2,036.18 toward a ₹2,620.00 Base target.
